cases.name: bgp-peer-type-cli-text

cases.name: link-to-tp-of-other-network

cases.name: l3nm-route-target-cli-text

cases.name: l3nm-access-profile-not-active
cases.note: an access names a VPN instance profile its node does not activate

cases.name: l2nm-auto-discovery-without-bgp-ad
cases.note: RFC 9291: bgp-auto-discovery (RD, targets) exists only with bgp-ad-enabled

cases.name: l2nm-evpn-signaling-option
cases.note: RFC 9291 defect: the evpn-bgp case's pbb when names 'pbb-evpn' unprefixed, which ietf-l2vpn-ntw does not define; no instance of the case validates, so IOS 'vlan-based' is not exported

cases.name: ldp-interface-without-ipv4
cases.note: RFC 9070: an LDP interface must have IPv4 or IPv6 in the interface tree

cases.name: ldp-session-state-cli-text
cases.note: the IOS 'Oper' column is not an RFC 9070 session-state enum (operational)

cases.name: bgp-afi-safi-cli-text
cases.note: the CLI 'l2vpn evpn' family is IANA identity l2vpn-evpn, not 'evpn'

cases.name: fabric-device-outside-tree
cases.note: RFC 8542 device-ref is an instance-identifier: the device node must exist

cases.name: bgp-ls-missing-import
cases.note: BGP-LS YANG -04 imports iana-bgp-types; no BGP model version defines it

cases.name: flexi-grid-pinned-old-te
cases.note: expired draft pins ietf-te revision-date 2019-02-15, which no source keeps

cases.name: oam-mount-point-on-anydata
cases.note: RFC 8532: mount-point on anydata; RFC 8528 §3.1: container/list only

cases.name: vrrp-interval-seconds-to-centiseconds
cases.note: a seconds value mapped onto RFC 8347's centisecond node

cases.name: vrrp-interval-seconds
cases.note: same value onto the VRRPv2 seconds node
